git history / the diff / the plan

step_1_characterize_the_delta.rounding_band: Golden leaves carry one decimal. If the change is a single multiplicative factor r applied to an unrounded raw u, then round1(u)=94.1 and round1(r*u)=101.7 force r in [101.65/94.15, 101.75/94.05] = [1.079660, 1.081871].
step_1_characterize_the_delta.conclusion: Exactly one canonical amplifier constant lies in that band: r = 1.08, i.e. a +8.0% damage amplifier. (1.05 is excluded: 94.05-94.15 x 1.05 = 98.8, and a 5%->8% upgrade is excluded: x1.02857 = 96.8.)
step_1_characterize_the_delta.implied_unrounded_prior_value: u in [94.1204, 94.1500); e.g. u = 94.14 -> 94.14 x 1.08 = 101.6712 -> 101.7, while u itself rounds to 94.1. Self-consistent.

step_2_locate_the_8_percent_in_the_cache.black_cleaver_cannot_explain_it: data/items.json id 3071 'Black Cleaver': stats 40 AD / 400 health / 20 ability haste; passive Carve = '6% armor reduction, up to 30% at 5 stacks'; passive Fervor = 20 movement speed. Armor reduction acts on the mitigation multiplier m(R)=100/(100+R), never on pre-mitigation raw damage, so Black Cleaver cannot move a raw_damage leaf.
step_2_locate_the_8_percent_in_the_cache.bloodsong_does: data/items.json id 3877 'Bloodsong', passive Spellblade: '...inflict them with Expose Weakness for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources (1.5 second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).' The parsed atom (data/atoms/items.json -> '3877' -> damage.bonus, evidence 'passive:Spellblade@kw:increased damage') carries values [10.0, 100.0, 4.0, 8.0, 5.0, 1.5] with units [s, percent, s, percent, percent, flat] - i.e. the 8%/5% pair survives parsing.
step_2_locate_the_8_percent_in_the_cache.rd_template_orientation: {{rd|A|B}} = A for a melee wielder, B for a ranged wielder. Verified against a known item in the same cache: Tiamat (3077) Cleave = '{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}', which is the melee 40% / ranged 20% Tiamat-line cleave. Therefore Expose Weakness = +8% for a melee Bloodsong wielder, +5% for a ranged one.
step_2_locate_the_8_percent_in_the_cache.no_competing_source: The only other +8% amplifiers in the cache are Press the Attack (data/runes.json, damage_amp_ratio 0.08, self-only 'grant you 8% increased damage') and Riftmaker's Void Corruption (2%/s to 8%); neither is named by the scenario, whose two named items are exactly Black Cleaver and Bloodsong.

step_3_placement_of_the_amp_in_raw_damag.quote: docs/math-foundations.md 1.2: 'the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance'.
step_3_placement_of_the_amp_in_raw_damag.consequence: Because mitigation is linear in raw, folding the multiplicative Expose Weakness factor into raw_damage and mitigating afterwards is numerically identical to amplifying post-mitigation. Reporting the amplifier inside raw_damage is therefore an exact, not an approximate, representation - the leaf legitimately moves by the full 8%.

step_4_should_the_amp_be_live_at_event_5.reasoning: Expose Weakness lasts 4 s with a 1.5 s internal cooldown that starts after the empowered attack, and is re-applied by every Spellblade-empowered basic attack (ability -> next basic attack within 10 s). Event index 50 sits deep in a sustained coupled fight in which the wielder is casting and auto-attacking, so the debuff is up. Its wording - 'increased damage from ALL sources' - is precisely why the fixture is a *roster* scenario: the debuff amplifies every participant's damage, not only the wielder's.
step_4_should_the_amp_be_live_at_event_5.conclusion: Omitting it (the old value) understates the event; including it at the melee rate (the new value) matches the wiki text.

independent_computation.arithmetic: raw_new = raw_old_unrounded x (1 + 0.08). With raw_old_unrounded ~= 94.14 (displays as 94.1): 94.14 x 1.08 = 101.67 -> 101.7. Matches the new value; the old value equals the same event with the amplifier omitted.

assumption_and_falsifier.assumption: The Bloodsong wielder in this fixture is MELEE, so the wiki's melee branch (8%) is the one that applies.
assumption_and_falsifier.support: Black Cleaver's Carve only stacks off *physical* damage and needs 5 repeated applications, so a fixture that pairs Black Cleaver with Bloodsong is built around a melee physical-damage wielder; and the measured step is exactly the melee constant 8%, not the ranged 5%.
assumption_and_falsifier.falsifier: If the Bloodsong wielder is ranged, the correct amplifier is 5% and the correct leaf would be ~98.8 - in that case BOTH values would be wrong. I could not read the scenario roster (it lives in scripts/, outside the permitted evidence tree), so this is stated explicitly rather than assumed away.
assumption_and_falsifier.excluded_alternative: A 'wrong participant's base AD' story (Spellblade deals 100% base AD; Aphelios L18 base AD = 55 + 2.3*17 = 94.1 and Yuumi L18 base AD = 49 + 3.1*17 = 101.7) also lands on both numbers, but it requires the fixture to swap which champion's base AD feeds an ally-held Spellblade, which no cached source motivates; and ~170 champions cover roughly 40% of one-decimal values in the 90-130 range, so the double hit is a weak coincidence rather than evidence.

verdict_rationale: The leaf moves by exactly +8.0% (the only amplifier constant compatible with the one-decimal rounding band 1.07966-1.08187). +8% is verbatim the melee branch of Bloodsong's Expose Weakness in the cached wiki text, the only damage amplifier attached to either item named by the scenario; Black Cleaver's armor shred provably cannot move a pre-mitigation leaf. Folding the amplifier into raw_damage is exact because mitigation is linear in raw (math-foundations 1.2). 101.7 is therefore the value the cached sources support; 94.1 is the same event with the roster-wide Expose Weakness amplifier missing.
